title: Mock model array results are call-indexed after recording calls
summary: MockLanguageModelV3/V4 and MockEmbeddingModelV3/V4 record each call before selecting from array backed scripted results, so the array index must subtract one from the call count length. Issue 15141 verified this for doGe
body:
MockLanguageModelV3/V4 and MockEmbeddingModelV3/V4 record each call before selecting from array-backed scripted results, so the array index must subtract one from the call-count length. Issue #15141 verified this for doGenerate, doStream, and doEmbed; focused tests live in src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts and src/test/mock-embedding-model.test.ts.
Evidence: Targeted Vitest before fix returned second embedding result on first call; after fix pnpm --filter ai exec vitest --config vitest.node.config.js --run src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts src/test/mock-embedding-model.test.ts passed 6 tests.
Verified by: pnpm --filter ai exec vitest --config vitest.node.config.js --run src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts src/test/mock-embedding-model.test.ts; pnpm --filter ai type-check; pnpm type-check:full; pnpm exec ultracite check targeted files
